findings.evidence: Own measurement, same population (400, seed 20261111, max M). Candidate: repair years of a row = T - min(T, max(0, T/c - 1)) (explicit event lists exact). Row level: B3 stage error mean +0.30%, p95 0.72%, max +1.44%, min -1.6e-13 (rounding), under-estimated in 0 of 400; relative to whole-life total max +0.23%. Class-parameter form (per material class only two numbers: sum e0*r and the e0*r-weighted harmonic mean cycle; equipment as one class): stage mean +0.33%, p95 0.83%, max +1.46%, min -1.6e-13, 0 of 400 under; total max +0.24%. AP-04 on the same scenarios: mean +2.05%, max +5.42%; AP-18b: -1.88%..+1.13%, 61.5% under.
